column1: # Table S3 - alternative explanations, what each one predicts against what was measured
# Each row is one explanation of the form the footprint is not a protein but something else.
# If that explanation held, some number would have to move a certain way. The prediction is
# written first and the measured value sits beside it.
# The unit differs from row to row, so a comparison is only valid within a row.
# Row 2 (nucleosome absorption) is measured on the two way methylation split - m6A/A of
# molecules with no nucleosome over the interval centred on -35..+27, inside the TFIIIB zone
# window -28..-10. Low 11,727 A positions over 2,933 molecules, high 10,225 A positions over
# 2,555 molecules. Baseline to compare against - molecules that DO carry a nucleosome in the
# same window, low 0.1254 and high 0.1078, so the measured values are 3.5 times (low) and
# 4.3 times (high) higher. The alternative is excluded. Produced by s3row2.py.
